approvedFacts.text: International House is a 1933 American pre-Code comedy film starring Peggy Hopkins Joyce and W.
Edward Sutherland and released by Paramount Pictures.
The tagline of the film was "The Grand Hotel of comedy".
Poppy Ackroyd is a British composer, pianist and violinist and a regular member of the live project Hidden Orchestra.

She is known for her "non-conformist approach to producing sounds" and while her debut album consisted of violin and piano played by Ackroyd, Resolve, incorporated improvisation from Manu Delago, Jo Quail and Mike Lesirge.

Biography
Ackroyd grew up in Bermondsey in London and her father is visual artist Norman Ackroyd.
